app_fee.value: An application fee of $65 U.S. is required for graduate admission applications.
app_fee.quote: Please note, an application fee of $65 U.S. is required.

fee_waiver.value: Drexel states that no application fee waivers are offered.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional across graduate programs.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL score of 90 is required for graduate admission (some departments require 100).

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS score of 6.5 overall band is required for graduate admission (some departments require 7.0).

english_waiver.value: English language test is only waived if applicant graduated from a US institution; foreign/Indian English-medium degrees are not waived.
english_waiver.quote: This requirement will be waived if the applicant graduated from a US institution of higher education.*

notes: Drexel has no single graduate-school PhD rule on fees, GRE or English. Each college sets its own, so the rules sit in each program record. Blocked or unreachable: https://catalog.drexel.edu/graduateprograms/ (502), https://catalog.drexel.edu/2027-2028/graduate/computer-information-sciences/ (502). A guessed page https://drexel.edu/graduate-studies/admissions returned 404. The College of Engineering doctoral page (https://drexel.edu/engineering/admissions/graduate/doctoral/) states TOEFL 90 / IELTS 6.5 but refers to Fall 2021 as current, so it was not used.
